  "(a1)": "E nakonako nakon te auti Meeri ningaabong.",
  "(a2)": "Mary will walk to the house tomorrow.",
  "(b1)": "I tekateka inanon te kawai ŋai.",
  "(b2)": "I am sitting in the road.",
  "(c1)": "A nakonako nakon te kawai te ataei n te bong aei.",
  "(c2)": "The child is walking to the road today. The Gilbertese sentence has an agreement error: a is used with the singular subject te ataei."
}
